name: PILLAR Corporation
summary: PILLAR Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, and sells various fluid control equipment in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments, Electronic Equipment Business and Industrial Equipment Business. The company offers fittings, pumps, and other components made from fluororesin for the semiconductor, LCD, and medical industries; mechanical seal, which control fluid from rotating equipment like centrifugal pumps that supply fluids; gland packing products, a seal materials for valve stem components; and gasket products, go between pipes. It also provides semiconductor cleaning equipment; structure fitted with seismic isolators; and fluororesin antenna substrates products…
